name: 长生·华构人间 / Inhabited Chinese Fantasy

source_summary.provenance: Directly inspected 18 sampled frames (4 also enlarged) from one locally downloaded film, 继承者大会初试：何为长生？, video ID 7679721093191585074, on 2026-09-07. Source evidence and timestamps: references/changsheng-style.md. Raw reference pixels are not distributed.

visual_rules.medium_behavior: Photographic Chinese period-fantasy film still: inhabited physical sets, expressive human faces, richly made but hierarchically restrained costume, and spatially integrated fantasy scale.
palette_logic: Warm wood and muted bronze occupy built surfaces; blue-green belongs to recesses and distant shade, with readable warm skin.
Choose daylight ivory and amber, cool window-lit night, or warm timber hall according to the scene; do not apply one teal-orange wash.
A character may own a restrained plum, wine-red, ink-blue or pale neutral costume family; assign by role rather than coloring everyone identically.
visual_rules.shape_line_language: Layered rooflines, posts, railings and openings establish near/mid/far depth. Costume silhouettes use overlapping collars, shaped outer layers and gravity-led drape; detail concentrates near collar, cuffs and hair fastenings.
texture_material_logic: Wood, stone, bronze, dense woven cloth and translucent outer fabric have distinct roughness and weight; metal catches small highlights while textiles retain folds.
Skin retains age, facial planes and fine local texture. Hair forms coherent masses with a few loose strands; ornaments have visible attachment points.
Embroidery and metallic trim are locally concentrated rather than all-over ornamental noise.
visual_rules.lighting_logic: Motivated window or overhead daylight shapes faces and traverses the set; small warm practicals may articulate the depth. Air haze belongs to backlit spatial gaps. Eyes remain legible while distant crowds and ornament recede.
composition_logic: Choose either an inhabited establishing view, a relationship medium shot, or a face/hand evidence close-up according to the current brief.
For institutional spaces, levels, viewing directions and partial foreground obstructions make hierarchy readable; use a new plan for each target setting.
Portraits keep face and gesture primary, costume secondary and the environment legible but lower-contrast.
visual_rules.optics_rendering_logic: Photographic depth falloff, coherent perspective, soft highlight rolloff and selectively sharp eyes and garment edges; atmosphere reduces distant contrast without smearing the entire face.

inferred_traits: Architecture and costume communicate social position before dialogue.
Fantasy scale is persuasive because faces, daily activity and tactile materials remain grounded.
unknowns: Original image/video models, prompts, makeup products, lens, film stock and hidden production pipeline.
Exact motion and audio performance are outside this still-style sampling.
transfer_rules: Transfer lighting, depth, material hierarchy and role-based costume design while inventing new people, garment patterns and architecture.

Apply scene rules only when the target includes a setting; apply period costume design only when the requested world permits it. Existing wardrobe, identity and cultural requirements remain authoritative.
Design hair, makeup and accessories from the target role, age and action. Use natural skin, deliberate brow/eye/lip emphasis and securely attached sparse ornaments; preserve facial individuality.
Keep unusual props, supernatural skin/eyes, elaborate crowns, circular arenas and dramatic haze optional and explicitly motivated by the new brief.
forbidden_transfer: Source faces, named characters, exact clothing patterns or jewelry designs.
Source plot, dialogue, subtitles, watermarks or exact camera/architecture layout.
Automatic wheelchairs, giant trees, mechanical hearts, vampire features or tournament staging.

prompts: Create an original lived-in fantasy environment film frame: a tidal archive receiving its first visitor after a flood.
Create an original adult female textile guild master, age 48, pausing at her workshop doorway after an argument; medium close-up for character hair, makeup and costume design.
validation.notes: Two fresh text-only image tests visually reviewed on 2026-09-07. Transfer passed with hairstyle/material and opulence limitations recorded in evidence. User approved durable inclusion and global installation. This is not full source-film equivalence.

evidence.review: Retained layered timber/stone galleries, foreground occlusion, readable small human activity, light from open sky, differentiated surfaces and a new coastal setting. No source-specific arena, giant tree, face or copy visible. Limitation: More subdued and civic than the most opulent source scenes; opening-hand action is small at this scale.

Retained mature facial texture, readable brow/eye/lip makeup, ink-blue/ivory/plum garment layers, localized collar/cuff embroidery, attached earrings, motivated window light and lower-contrast workshop depth. New identity and occupation. Limitation: Bun is higher than the requested low coil; silk reads relatively matte/coarse. Not exact hairstyle or fabric reproduction.
